name: Mitten Extracts Max Pro Disposable | Rainbow Gushers
description:
Bursting with sweet, fruity flavor, Rainbow Gushers brings a candy-inspired profile that’s bright, juicy, and full of character. This Max Pro disposable delivers bold flavor with every pull, creating a smooth and satisfying experience that keeps fans coming back for more.

Packed with 3G of Liquid Diamonds + Live Resin terpenes for a smooth, powerful experience that lasts. Fine-tune every hit with Flavor, Balance, or Clouds mode.
